title: Summit Membership Age Waiver on Crestline Companion Fare Retention
content:
Holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes are recognised for the age of their Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program. When a companion fare refund carries a cancellation retention, a membership-age waiver is read from the whole calendar months between the enrolled date of the holder's Summit membership and the handling date:

| Whole calendar months from the enrolled date to the handling date | Waiver of the cancellation retention |
|---|---|
| 120 months or more | 40 percent |
| 60 months to fewer than 120 months | 20 percent |
| fewer than 60 months | none |

The enrolled date is the date the Summit membership was opened, as shown on the holder's Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Enrolled date | Handling date | Whole months | Waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2014 | 15 March 2024 | 120 | 40 percent |
| 15 March 2014 | 14 March 2024 | 119 | 20 percent |
| 15 March 2019 | 15 March 2024 | 60 | 20 percent |
| 15 March 2019 | 14 March 2024 | 59 | none |
